title: Historical Jezero environmental observations
selection: Actual air/pressure samples nearest the existing hourly-selected ground-temperature observations, within 30 spacecraft-clock seconds. Individual source times are retained; samples are not necessarily simultaneous. No interpolation, averaging, model or zone-wide extrapolation.
spatialCoverage: Approximate recorded rover positions only. Marker uses the selected ground-observation reference position; individual air/pressure positions are supplied where ancillary timing permits. Not conditions at the simulated astronaut, habitat or entire route.
airInterpretation: Calibrated local detector temperatures, not a model-corrected ambient air estimate. Rover heating, illumination and sensor placement can affect representativeness. No detector average or best-detector rule is invented.
pressureUncertaintyNote: Selected DER_PS labels declare kelvin for PRESSURE UNCERTAINTY. Preserve this inconsistency; do not convert it into a made-up Pa uncertainty.
qualityNote: Products supply no per-row quality flags for these selected variables. Review required is retained, not a passed-quality or EVA-safety claim. Numerical ingestion bounds are not astronaut limits.
